qualityRuns: All use the same frozen 60-example synthetic test split. No test-driven retraining was performed.
overlap: Base Transformers evaluation overlapped the adapter evaluation, one candidate serving experiment, and later the existing Ollama baseline. Latencies from these runs are descriptive under shared laptop load, not a controlled speedup estimate.
protocolDifference: Base/adapter use identical unconstrained greedy Transformers generation with 1400 new tokens. The application Ollama baseline uses its existing JSON-schema generation with 2048 tokens. This is an application comparison, not an architecture-isolated model comparison.
cost: No rented GPU or paid inference API was used for these experiments. Existing laptop electricity, bandwidth and free-tier service quotas still apply.
trainingFailure: The 120-step LoRA run stopped on CUDA OOM at step 71. Only the saved validation checkpoint at step 40 is evaluated.
